properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_cross_design_read_takes_the_other_design_by_graph_id.rs: against a registry server holding designs A and B — a session on A with _meta reflow2/readable_graph_ids [A,B] gets a diff / composed report naming B; B absent from the set → refused naming B and saying nothing of what it holds; no _meta → refused naming the key; A's own graph_id → refused; compare_designs with a path on the registry server → refused ("a path is not served here"); A→B and B→A concurrently (6 rounds each) finish without deadlock. One in-process test and five wire tests. It is the check of dec:a-cross-design-read-is-bounded-by-the-readable-set-the-host-hands-over-not-by-the-root-alone as well.
